description: A two-column nomenclature table rendered as an image, headed "List of symbols". It is not a data plot: the left column holds the symbol and the right column its definition, and it is divided into two blocks, "Greek symbols" (given first) and "Arabic symbols" (second, beginning lower down the page). The Greek block runs from α, α_dis, γ and γ_m (grain boundary energy between cell i and its neighbour / of a high angle boundary, J/m²), through δD_ob (m³/s), the strain-increment and dislocation-density terms Δε, Δε_slip^r(i,j,k), Δt, Δρ^r(i,j,k), Δσ_0, ε, ε_c, ε̇ (s⁻¹), ε̇_GBS^r(i,j,k), ζ_v, θ_0, θ_i, θ_m, μ and μ_0 (MPa, μ_0 at 300 K), ρ_av, ρ_c, ρ_max, ρ_sat, ρ^r(i,j,k), and the stress family σ, σ_v, σ_0, σ_s, σ_ss, σ_c, σ_p, σ_a, σ_η0/σ_ηs/σ_ηss (all MPa), ending with τ, ν, φ_d, ϕ_d and ψ (used for t_0.5). The Arabic block lists A, A_GB, A_0, A_c, A_s, A_ss, b, C, C_drx, d_r, d_ave, d_2D, d_3D, dρ_WH, dρ^r_WH(i,j,k), E (J/mol), f, H and H_GB. The table documents the symbols of a 3D cellular-automaton DRX model for low-alloy steel; it carries definitions only, no measured data.

subfigures.description: Header row reading 'List of symbols', followed by the section subheading 'Greek symbols' and ~40 rows mapping each Greek/mathematical symbol (α, α_dis, γ, γ_m, δD_ob, Δε, Δε_slip^r(i,j,k), Δt, Δρ^r(i,j,k), Δσ_0, ε, ε_c, ε̇, ε̇_GBS^r(i,j,k), ζ_v, θ_0, θ_i, θ_m, μ, μ_0, ρ_av, ρ_c, ρ_max, ρ_sat, ρ^r(i,j,k), σ, σ_v, σ_0, σ_s, σ_ss, σ_c, σ_p, σ_a, σ_η0/σ_ηs/σ_ηss, τ, ν, φ_d, ϕ_d, ψ) to its textual definition, with units J/m², m³/s, s⁻¹ and MPa given where applicable.

Section subheading 'Arabic symbols' with ~19 rows mapping Latin-letter symbols (A, A_GB, A_0, A_c, A_s, A_ss, b, C, C_drx, d_r, d_ave, d_2D, d_3D, dρ_WH, dρ^r_WH(i,j,k), E, f, H, H_GB) to definitions, including units J/mol for the diffusion activation energy E. The image is cropped just below the H_GB row.

observations.observation: The image is a symbol/notation table titled 'List of symbols', not a plot or micrograph; it has two columns (symbol, definition) and no axes, scale bars or data values.
The table is split into two labelled blocks: 'Greek symbols' first, then 'Arabic symbols'.
γ is defined as 'grain boundary energy between cell i and its neighbor, J/m2' and γ_m as 'grain boundary energy of a high angle boundary, J/m2'.
ε̇ is defined as 'effective strain rate, s-1', and ε_c as 'critical strain for the onset of DRX'.

A family of characteristic stresses in MPa is defined: σ (effective stress), σ_v (flow stress corresponding to WH and DRV), σ_0 (yield stress), σ_s (saturation stress), σ_ss (steady-state stress), σ_c (critical stress for the onset of DRX), σ_p (peak stress) and σ_a (athermal stress).
μ is defined as 'temperature-dependent shear modulus, MPa' and μ_0 as 'the shear modulus when the temperature is 300 K, MPa'.
ρ^r(i,j,k) is defined as the dislocation density of the cell with coordinates (i, j, k) in the grain r, and Δρ^r(i,j,k) as its net change caused by WH and DRV.
E is defined as 'diffusion activation energy, J/mol', the only energy-unit quantity in the Arabic-symbol block.
Δt is defined as 'time step of CA models', identifying the model as a cellular automaton.

Symbols for 2D and 3D grain size are defined as d_2D ('average 2D grain size') and d_3D ('average 3D grain size'), alongside d_ave ('average grain diameter in the RVE') and d_r ('diameter of the r-th grain in the RVE').
The caption text supplied with this figure is the same list-of-symbols table and provides no additional information beyond what is visible in the pixels.
The bottom edge of the image cuts off after the row 'H_GB — diffusion coefficient applied for the calculation of GBS strain rate', so any further symbol rows are not visible.
